name: ClearingInstruction
description: All information required to perform the clear life cycle event; the clearing party (CCP), the two parties facing each other on the alpha contract, and optionally the parties acting as clearing members.

alphaContract.description: The contract that will be submitted to the clearing house for clearing. The contract should indicate that it should be cleared by assigning a clearing organisation as a party role.

clearerParty1.description: Optional party facing the CCP, acting as clearing member for party1.

clearerParty2.description: Optional party facing the CCP, acting as clearing member for party2.

clearingParty.description: The Central Counter party (CCP) that the contract will be submitted to for clearing.

party1.description: First party facing the CCP if it is clearing for its own account.

party2.description: Second party facing the CCP if it is clearing for its own account.
